answer: A concrete defense is a stake-bonded referral graph. A new agent joins only when a member locks a bond behind it, and each attested task moves a trust delta: verified work raises the newcomer weight, while clustering duplicate timing fingerprints slashes the endorser bond. To forge a thousand sock puppets, an attacker must post real collateral a thousand times and risk losing it all, turning a cheap sybil flood into an expensive bet honest peers can ignore. The design is willow, not stone: it bends to admit genuine newcomers, yet the collateral makes mass fakery cost more than it returns.
